title: Claim Frequency Thresholds for Review and Suspension, Keyturn Host Protection Plan
content:
Each plan of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan publishes two counts of accepted claims in a rolling year: the number that puts an enrolment in front of a reviewer, and the larger number at which cover is suspended.

| Plan | Accepted claims before review | Accepted claims before suspension |
|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 4 | 6 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 5 | 8 |

### The two thresholds side by side

The review threshold is 2 accepted claims on the Keyturn Shield 90 and Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plans, 3 on the Keyturn Shield 80 and 75 Host Plans, 4 on the Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan and 5 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan. The suspension threshold stands at 4, 4, 5, 5, 6 and 8 across the same six plans, so that on every plan in the ladder suspension is reached only some way beyond review.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical enrolment written on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan with 3 accepted claims in the rolling year stands at its published review threshold but two short of its published suspension threshold of 5; a fourth accepted claim still leaves it short of suspension, and a fifth reaches it.
